fixed.summary: A document's `ex`, `cap`, `rex` and `rcap` now read the body face's own x-height and cap height (OS/2) instead of 0.5em and the ascent. `ch` and `ic` use the advance of the face's `0` and 水, and fall back to CSS Values 4's 0.5em and 1em when the face lacks the glyph. They used to take the .notdef advance.
